style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: one action per beat each; he never holds a pose; the roll grows every beat; new camera move and shot size every beat
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, thin long fingers, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, alarmed
second_characters: ONE fat toad banker in a striped tie, throat ballooning, unrolling the schedule at the lens, never still
props: ONE honey-oak desk; ONE long paper roll of a payment schedule, ruled in blank squares; ONE round red stamp in the toad's paw; his tie; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the roll in frame all clip; the red stamp mark lands on the roll at 7.2 and stays on the paper end to the finish
environment: a sunlit bank office, tall window, oak panelling

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: paper unspooling, a stamp thump, a toad croak, desk rattle

timeline.a: the toad's roll smacks the tarsier flat across the lens
he peels the paper off his face; the toad breathes on the stamp
he rears up tall, long fingers spread; the toad puffs its throat
his head snaps a half turn back, body forward
he runs the taut roll at the camera like a tightrope, arms out; the toad holds the stamp high
he bites the paper, it won't tear, he swings by his teeth
hands up, he is spun into a paper mummy by the toad
he hops along the desk in the cocoon
he bursts out of the cocoon toward the camera; the toad flinches
he leaps off the desk; the toad's stamp misses, thumping red onto the roll
the toad flings the roll out the tall window, he tumbles after it
he chases it on all fours across the desk; the toad croaks
he catches the end at the sill, it snaps him back like a spring
he lands upright, holding up the red-stamped paper end in both hands, tie over his shoulder; the toad flops in its chair
timeline.c: mid, waist up, slow push in

must_appear: the roll smacking him flat at 0.0, the toad's stamp raised while he speaks, the stamp thumping red onto the roll as he leaps at 7.2, the roll out the window at 7.5, him waist-up with the stamped paper end at 9.5
